description: We are building NISAR RiceRadar for the Dancing with the SARs challenge—an interactive dashboard using NASA SAR satellite data to track rice growth and flood risks in the Mekong Delta. We bring skills in web development, GIS visualization, and remote sensing data analysis, and welcome collaborators passionate about agriculture or satellite data science.
summary: I have developed an website to analyze Nisar radar data for everyone to use and understand the data while also providing prediction to the user.It solves the problem that many user find it difficult to understand the radar data.It is important because radar data from Nisar is one of the best data we can use for farming so it is vital to aware of what actually happen through the radar picture.
details: Our project is a web application that processes radar satellite imagery from NASA's NISAR mission into an intuitive, interactive grid to deliver predictive insights for future crop seasons. By transforming complex space observation data into user-friendly visualizations, it enables weather-independent monitoring to help farmers optimize agricultural planning, reduce risks, and improve food security. Built using web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and Python, the platform bridges the gap between advanced Earth science data and practical farming.
